description: This file contains the implementation of a PHP stream class that adheres to the PSR-7 StreamInterface. It provides methods for managing stream resources, including reading, writing, seeking, obtaining metadata, and converting the stream to a string. The class is part of the GuzzleHttp library, specifically within its PSR-7 implementation.

classes.name: Stream
classes.description: A PHP stream implementation conforming to PSR-7 StreamInterface, providing functionality for stream resource management, reading, writing, seeking, and metadata retrieval.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructs a Stream object, wrapping a resource with optional size and metadata.

methods.name: __destruct
methods.description: Closes the stream when the object is destructed.

methods.name: __toString
methods.description: Returns the entire stream contents as a string, seeking to start if seekable.

methods.name: getContents
methods.description: Reads all remaining contents from the stream.

methods.name: detach
methods.description: Detaches the resource from the Stream object, returning it and resetting the object state.

methods.name: getSize
methods.description: Returns the size of the stream if known.

methods.name: isReadable
methods.description: Checks if the stream is readable.

methods.name: isWritable
methods.description: Checks if the stream is writable.

methods.name: isSeekable
methods.description: Checks if the stream supports seeking.

methods.name: eof
methods.description: Checks if the stream is at end-of-file.

methods.name: tell
methods.description: Returns the current position within the stream.

methods.name: rewind
methods.description: Rewinds the stream to its beginning.

methods.name: seek
methods.description: Seeks to a specific position within the stream.

methods.name: read
methods.description: Reads a specified number of bytes from the stream.

methods.name: getMetadata
methods.description: Returns metadata about the stream or a specific key.
